calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-20-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: Sajja Ravinantapricha & Carla Amador, CSR: Patricia Abalos #13128 (Department 218)

Appearances:
Petitioner, Rodolfo Baltasar Narvaez, is present in propria persona.

This matter comes on calendar this day for an Order to Show Cause hearing re Change of Name. Rodolfo Baltasar Narvaez is sworn and examined by the Court.

The matter having been submitted and no objections having been made to the proposed change of name made at the hearing, it appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Rudy B. Narvaez. Decree is submitted and signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-06-2007 Reset To Nov-20-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Trish Abalos.
Petitioner: Rodolpho Baltasar Narvaez, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
Matter is continued to Nov. 20, 2007 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218 for Petitioner to file an Original Proof of Publication with the court.
